title: Palindrome sentence
prompt:
Write `IsPalindrome(s string) bool`. Only letters count (Latin and Cyrillic), and case doesn't matter. Spaces, punctuation and digits are ignored.

`"А роза упала на лапу Азора"` → `true`. An empty string is a palindrome.
hint: Two pointers over `[]rune`, skipping anything where `unicode.IsLetter` is false.
